scope_note: The sources establish representation and parameterized compilation results. They do not prove that arbitrary CNF has a polynomially discoverable polynomial-size structured representation and do not resolve P versus NP.

sources.title: SDD: A New Canonical Representation of Propositional Knowledge Bases
sources.role: Defines SDDs, vtrees, canonicity, polytime Boolean Apply, and a treewidth-based SDD upper bound.

sources.title: Connecting Width and Structure in Knowledge Compilation
sources.role: Constructive singly-exponential compilation from bounded-treewidth circuits to d-SDNNF and matching structured lower-bound context.

sources.title: SDDs are Exponentially More Succinct than OBDDs
sources.role: Shows that vtree-structured decisions can yield an exponential representation advantage over OBDDs on selected functions.

sources.title: Compilation and Fast Model Counting beyond CNF
sources.role: Extends bounded-incidence-treewidth d-DNNF compilation to O(1)-slim constraints, including parity-style constraints.

sources.title: Lower Bounds on Intermediate Results in Bottom-Up Knowledge Compilation
sources.role: Warns that a small final structured representation does not imply polynomial bottom-up Apply construction.

sources.title: Dynamic Minimization of Sentential Decision Diagrams
sources.role: Primary heuristic vtree-search context. C039 does not assume global optimality or a free vtree.
